capabilities: Render underline, superscript, subscript, highlight, and spoiler from delimiter syntax
Attach color tags to highlights and class tags to custom spans and fenced divs
Toggle each syntax type and insert formats via commands, hotkeys, and context menu
Customize highlight color palettes and predefined tags in settings
Support rendering of the added syntax in exported PDFs
disambiguation: It does not reformat existing Markdown layout; it adds new inline and block syntax that renders as styled text.
extras: Syntax rules documentation is moved to a separate page, so the README alone does not cover delimiter character rules. Known issues include delimiter escaping not working in preview mode. Can be installed via BRAT. Tested on Obsidian 1.7.x-1.8.x only.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown lacks built-in syntax for effects like underline, spoiler, or colored highlights, so users must fall back to HTML tags, which are harder to edit.

relations.evidence: Pandoc for the idea of some syntax
CommonMark and Github Flavored Markdown for the markdown specification

summary: Plugin that adds non-standard Markdown syntax for underline, superscript, subscript, colored highlight, spoiler, and custom spans, rendered without HTML tags.
